description: Northerncore (also known as Northern English Doomer or Northern English Aesthetic ) is a regional sub-genre of the global Doomer and Sovietwave aesthetic movements. Originating on TikTok and Instagram under the `#northerncore` hashtag, it focuses on the atmospheric, melancholic, and deeply grounded visual landscape of Northern England. This differs from traditional Doomerism , which often focuses purely on urban alienation, Northerncore balances bleak post-industrial gloom with strong regional pride, working-class heritage, and sprawling natural landscapes.
